about: samplePostcodes: random real addresses from the OSM index. 77088 = NW home area, 77002 = downtown, 77036 = southwest (Sharpstown/Gulfton), 77087 = southeast (Gulfgate/Park Place), 77016 = northeast (Trinity Gardens/East Little York). accuracyPostcodes: addresses checked against the US Census geocoder in tests/accuracy.mjs (77008 Heights, 77030 Medical Center, 77074 SW, 77017 SE, 77028 NE added).
